text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  claude-review:
    # Skip if it's a draft PR or from dependabot
    if: |
      !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
      !contains(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'dependabot/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          # Use the review prompt file if it exists, otherwise use a default inline prompt
          prompt: |
            You are an expert Rust developer reviewing a pull request for the foxglove-sdk repository.
            Please review the changes and provide feedback on:
            1. Correctness (logic errors, edge cases, race conditions)
            2. Design & architecture (API clarity, separation of concerns)
            3. Readability & maintainability
            4. Performance & scalability
            5. Security & safety
            6. Testing & observability
            7. Product & UX considerations
            
            Be constructive and specific. If the code looks good, say so!
          use_sticky_comment: true
```
